description:
Your coding agents don't stop when you leave the desk, so neither should you. Tailscode puts every agent running on your own computers in your pocket: Claude Code, opencode and Oh My Pi, on any model they can run, including one on your own graphics card. Start a task from the couch, check on six at once from anywhere, and get a ping when the long one finishes. Your chats go straight to your machines over your own Tailscale network, never through a relay, with no sign-in. Free and open source.

ONE COMMAND TO SET UP
For Claude Code, one line on the computer you code on installs the bridge and ends with a QR code. Scan it, confirm, and the app has your machine; opencode has a one-line installer too. Want to look first? A built-in demo shows the main screens with no server at all.

EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
• Home is one ranked board: a sentence that says who needs you and what is working, then the chats waiting on you, working, pinned and recent.
• The Agents board follows up to six running agents at once: the step each one is on, the command it is running or the file it is editing, with approve and answer on each card, and stop and nudge one tap deeper.
• Peek at any agent without opening its chat: its step, its last moves, its context.

ANY MODEL, EVEN YOUR OWN GPU
• Whatever your agent can run, from cloud models to a local model served by Ollama or llama.cpp on your own machine, picked per chat with its reasoning effort.
• Carry a conversation to another model: the next one gets a short brief of the chat and picks up the thread.
• A party of six favourite models and their effort levels, one tap or one swipe of the model pill away.

LONG RUNS, NO BABYSITTING
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen for a running conversation, one for each with Pro: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• Notifications say what happened: how long it took, what it changed and the first of what it said. Reply from the Lock Screen to start the next turn. An approval shows the exact command and asks for Face ID or your passcode; a question shows its options as buttons.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Streaming text, with thinking and tool runs folded into one readable trace per turn.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.
• Send screenshots and photos; every picture the agent hands back lands in a gallery.

NOT ONLY CODE
Your machines know things. Ask what is eating the GPU, research a question, tidy a folder, check a price: any agent, any model, from anywhere.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines, by model, project and tool. Always an estimate, never a bill.
• Plan limits and quotas per provider and account, on Home and in a widget.

YOURS, END TO END
• Your chats travel point to point over your tailnet, never through a relay. No sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and your code and conversations never reach us.
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, plus a Linux desktop app, all open source under GPL-3.0: the app, the engine and the bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core on one server: full chat, the Agents and Home boards, approvals, attachments, every model, a Live Activity at a time. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: unlimited servers in one list, concurrent Live Activities, iPhone and Mac on the same Apple Account, the delegate board, and a supporter heart.

Tailscode is independent open-source software, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy
Source code: https://github.com/guitaripod/Tailscode
promotionalText: Run Claude Code, opencode and Oh My Pi on your own computers, on any model they can run, even your own GPU, and keep up with all of them from your phone. No sign-in.
whatsNew:
New:
• Agents board and wall. What needs you (an approval with its command, or a question), what is working, what runs in the background and what finished in the last hour, per session with its agents and todos. Peek at a run, then open, stop or nudge it; approvals wait for Face ID. Watch opens the wall: every agent full screen, laid out for each pose, fold and size. Open the board from Home's status header or long-press the orb.
• Carry a conversation to another model: continue on another machine with a short brief, or branch a chat from any answer with Try with another model.
• A party of six models. The model pill opens six cards, each a model at a level on a named server; tap one to switch, hold it to edit.
• Meet Megatron. Thoughts, tool calls and notes become one head per turn: a short line while it works, and an open stage with numbered steps, pinning, replay and a Share poster.
• Ask by voice or Shortcut. Siri, Shortcuts and Vocal Shortcuts can send a quick ask, and compose links drop their words into the box as a draft.
• Talk to the agent, in beta: a call strip above the composer listens and types into the chat.
• Restart one server, or every server at once, from the app.
• The usage share is modular: a format for X, a square or a portrait, with the modules you choose.
• First run is one checklist: find the machine on your tailnet, pair, install claude-bridge and prove it answers.
• The picture and video studios list every missing ComfyUI model and node with a copy-the-command row, and the gallery is a wide grid.
• Quotas are one card per provider and account.

Changes:
• Where the server keeps a queue, queued messages wait there, and edit, cancel and resume go to the server.
• Game Center sign-in is opt-in.

Fixes:
• Long chats open and stream with less main-thread work, and leaving a chat frees its memory.
• Memory warnings release image, link and render caches.
• A double tap opens a chat once.
• Home no longer crashes when a model catalog changes.
• The status line holds still, and a failed quota read keeps the last good numbers.
• The context ring reads million-token models correctly.
• Attach stays available on models that cannot see pictures, with Files still working.
• opencode 2 conversations get their names.
